Is Orbix Studio the right fit for my business?

Orbix Studio is built for companies that want more than just great-looking design. We're the right fit for B2B SaaS, AI, and technology companies that need a partner to think through the product, improve the user experience, and turn ideas into solutions that are ready for real users. ‍ Most of our clients come to us when they're launching a new product, redesigning an existing platform, or preparing for their next stage of growth. ‍ We work best with Seed to Series B funded teams that have a live product and real users. Instead of hiring separate teams for branding, UI/UX, development, and creative work, they prefer working with one team that can manage the entire process. ‍ Our approach is collaborative and flexible. We take the time to understand your product, business goals, users, and technical requirements before recommending a solution. ‍ If your project matches our expertise, we'll build a clear roadmap and dedicated pod around it. If we don't believe we're the right partner, we'll tell you honestly and point you in the right direction.We're not a fit for pre-seed solo projects, one-off logo requests, or D2C e-commerce work.
What types of companies do you work with?

We primarily work with B2B SaaS, AI, and technology companies building digital products people use every day. Our clients range from early-stage startups validating their first product to improving existing platforms and launching new features. Over the years, we've partnered with 105+ SaaS founders and product teams across industries including fintech, healthcare, logistics, e-mobility, HR tech, real estate, and enterprise software. ‍ Named clients include Circle K, Privilee, RollUpLife Inc, GiveHub, Provida Family Medicine, and ADPList. We've delivered 140+ projects while helping our clients raise a combined $2B+ in capital. While every project is different, they all share the same goal - creating products that are easier to use, easier to scale, and built around real user needs. We also work with businesses that need more than a single service. ‍ Instead of hiring separate agencies for , UI/UX, websites, development, or creative production, our clients rely on one integrated team that understands their product and helps it evolve over time. ‍ This creates a more consistent experience across every stage of the project while keeping communication simple and the entire process moving forward.
Can you work with our existing team?

Absolutely. Many of our clients already have in-house designers, developers, product managers, or marketing teams when they start working with us. We integrate into your existing workflow instead of asking you to change the way your team works. We can support your team in different ways depending on your needs. Some clients bring us in to increase design capacity during busy periods, while others rely on us for specialized skills, product strategy, or . You decide where you need support, and we'll fill that gap without creating extra overhead. We work with the collaboration tools your team already uses - and others. You'll communicate directly with the people working on your project, making feedback faster, decisions clearer, and progress easier to track. We operate async-first: walkthroughs for every deliverable, shared boards, weekly syncs, and daily overlap hours with your team. become an extension of your team, not another layer to manage. That way, your internal team can stay focused on priorities while we help move the project forward with consistent communication and shared ownership.
Do you handle both design and development?

Yes. Design and development are part of the same workflow at Orbix Studio, so you don't need to manage separate agencies or coordinate handoffs between different teams. From product strategy and to , , , and , our designers and developers work together throughout the project. We ship focused and full . This speed comes from our parallel workflow: designers and developers work side-by-side, not sequentially. Our tech stack includes and , hosted on Google Cloud and AWS. This helps us make design decisions that are technically practical while ensuring the final product stays true to your vision. Keeping everything under one team also makes communication much simpler. Questions are resolved faster, feedback doesn't get lost between teams, and development can begin with a clear understanding of the design. The outcome is a smoother process, fewer delays, and a product that's built exactly as it was intended.
What makes Orbix different from other agencies?

We focus on building long-term product partnerships, not just delivering design files. Instead of offering a single service, we bring together and under one team. That means you don't have to coordinate multiple agencies to move your product forward. Our designers and developers work together from the beginning of every project, helping ideas move from planning to launch with fewer delays and clearer communication. We also bundle AI-accelerated creative production - AI video, AI product visuals, AI image enhancement, and scaled campaign assets - into the same workflow. No separate tool. No extra markup. Most importantly, we publish outcomes. Our clients report in design capacity, 60% reduction in time-to-market, and activation/conversion lift within the first month of engagement. These aren't averages - they're outcomes we measure and stand behind. We also believe the best work comes from collaboration, not complicated processes. You'll work directly with the people building your product, receive regular updates, and have a clear view of progress at every stage. Whether it's a new MVP or an established SaaS platform, our goal is to become a reliable extension of your team and help you build products that continue to grow long after launch.

Every project starts with a free discovery call to understand your product, goals, and challenges. These calls typically take . Before the meeting, our team reviews any information you share - your website, product, ads, or project brief - so we can have a productive conversation instead of asking basic questions. After the call, we'll recommend the best approach based on your objectives, whether that's improving an existing product, building something new, or solving a specific design or development challenge. You'll receive a clear project scope, estimated timeline, deliverables, and a proposed team, so you'll know exactly what to expect before any work begins. Kickoff happens within five business days of signing. New engagements start with a one-week trial (20 hours); if the first deliverable misses expectations, we redo it free or refund the prorated amount. From there, work together in a shared workflow, with regular progress updates and feedback sessions to keep the project moving smoothly from start to finish.
Who will work on my project?

You'll work with a dedicated pod of 2–5 people selected for your project. Depending on your requirements, that may include senior product designers, full-stack developers, branding specialists, UX researchers, motion designers, or illustrators - all led by an experienced project lead who keeps everything aligned. From the start, you'll communicate directly with the people doing the work rather than through multiple layers of account managers. This keeps feedback clear, speeds up decision-making, and ensures everyone understands your product, goals, and priorities throughout the project. As your project evolves, we can expand the team with additional specialists when needed. This gives you the flexibility to scale without the hassle of finding and onboarding new freelancers or agencies for every stage of your product's growth. Our team operates across four distributed offices: and . This gives us coverage across US, EU, and GCC business hours, and means your project can move forward around the clock.
Can you work with tight deadlines?

Yes, as long as we agree on the scope and timeline upfront. Many of our clients work toward product launches, investor presentations, marketing campaigns, or feature releases with fixed deadlines, so delivering on time is built into how we work. We ship conversion-ready websites in , brand identities in , and most focused projects in . Before any project begins, we break the work into clear milestones and prioritize the most important deliverables first. This helps everyone stay aligned, reduces last-minute surprises, and keeps progress moving even when timelines are tight. Because our designers and developers work as one team, decisions happen faster and there are fewer delays between design, feedback, and implementation. If a deadline isn't realistic, we'll be upfront about it and recommend an approach that balances speed with quality. Our goal is to deliver work you can confidently launch - not simply deliver it as quickly as possible.

We understand that startups move quickly and priorities can change. That's why our process is designed to stay flexible, helping teams validate ideas, launch new features, and iterate based on real user feedback without slowing down progress. To support different stages of growth, we offer both fixed-scope projects and monthly subscriptions starting at for our Part-Time plan. Growing teams can choose our Full-Time plan at , while larger organizations can request a custom engagement built around their product, team size, and roadmap. Our services are best suited for startups that are serious about building a scalable product and are looking for a long-term design and development partner. If you're still exploring an idea, we're happy to discuss your goals and recommend the best next step before starting a project.
Can you support us after launch?

Yes. Launching your product is just the beginning. Many of our clients continue working with us after launch to improve their product, add new features, refine the user experience, and support their business as it grows. As your users provide feedback and your goals evolve, we'll help you prioritize improvements, expand your product, and maintain a consistent experience across every update. Whether it's designing new screens, developing additional features, refreshing your website, or creating new marketing assets, your team can continue working with the people who already understand your product. Our retainer model is designed for this - flexible plans you can pause, cancel, or downgrade anytime with 14 days' notice. No setup fees, overage charges, or hidden invoices. You get full access to all services: UI/UX design, SaaS design, branding, , motion, and AI creative production. This long-term approach means you won't have to onboard a new agency every time your business changes. Instead, you'll have a trusted design and development partner that's ready to support your product through every stage of its growth.

elements.text: Swipe Drinks is a mobile app designed to replace cash at events by using digital tokens to buy beverages.
The project focused on making drink purchases fast and cashless, adding a social layer where users can send tokens to friends, and giving parents control over their children's spending.
UX Design, UI Design, Mobile App Design

Our task was to design Swipe Drinks to serve two very different users. Kids and teens needed a fun, fast, and social way to buy drinks and send tokens to friends. Parents needed a secure way to load tokens, set spending limits, and monitor activity.
People Needed a Clearer Way to Pick Drinks and Use Tokens
We had to make the flow feel easy right away, so users could see what was available, understand their token balance, and keep moving without slowing down.
Getting from the first screen to a drink choice needed to feel more direct.
Users needed a simple way to see what they had and how to use it.
The screens needed more structure so the main actions stood out faster.
The app had to feel tied to the event, not just like a plain drink menu.
Made the Drink Flow Easier to Follow
We simplified the layout, made token use easier to understand, and gave each screen a clearer path so people could move through the app without confusion.
Organized the steps so users could browse, choose, and continue more naturally.
Made token count and usage easier to spot at a glance.
Cleaned up the screens so the main actions felt more focused and easier to scan.
We used a more playful visual style so the app felt tied to the experience.
A Simple Design Process for Swipe Drinks App
The work focused on clearing up the screens, making tokens easier to understand, and keeping the experience easy to move through.
Started by looking at how people would use the app at an event and where the flow could feel unclear.
Mapped out the steps so choosing drinks and using tokens felt more direct.
Built a bright, playful interface that made the app feel fun but still easy to use.
Polished the screens and adjusted details so the final design felt clear and ready to hand off.
What People Needed From the App
We looked at how the app would work in a , what users would need to understand fast, and where the experience might slow down.
Looked at how the app would fit into a live event setting.
Checked how people would browse and pick drinks.
Reviewed how token use should be shown clearly.
Found that the experience needed to feel quick and easy.
Making the Flow Easy to Understand
The first part of the work focused on how people would . The goal was to make the steps feel clear from the start, so users could understand the drink flow without stopping to figure things out.

That meant looking at how the token system worked, where the screen could feel confusing, and how each step could lead into the next one more naturally. The layout was kept simple so the main actions stayed easy to see.
Giving the App a Fun, Event-Ready Look
The visual side focused on making the app feel bright, playful, and tied to the event experience. The design needed to feel light and easy, while still looking polished and well put together.

Color, spacing, and image treatment were used to make the screens more engaging without making them feel busy. The final look helped the app feel more alive and made the drink experience feel more interesting to use.

After the work, the app felt more organized, , and smoother to move through. The main actions stood out better, the token part made more sense, and the whole experience felt more ready for an event setting.

What does Orbix Studio specialize in?

Orbix Studio specializes in designing and building B2B SaaS, AI, and digital products that solve real business problems. ‍ Rather than trying to serve every industry or offer every creative service, we focus on helping product companies create experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and built for long-term growth. Our expertise spans the entire product journey, from product strategy and branding to UI/UX design, websites, mobile apps, and full-stack development. ‍ Because these disciplines work together under one team, we're able to solve product challenges from both a design and technical perspective instead of treating them as separate tasks. We've published 44+ case studies documenting how we've helped different products succeed - from small MVPs to established platforms. ‍ This archive represents real work across fintech, healthcare, HR tech, logistics, e-mobility, and enterprise software. This experience has helped us develop a deep understanding of how digital products are built, launched, and improved over time. Instead of trying to be everything for everyone, we've chosen to specialize in the products, industries, and challenges where we know we can create the greatest impact. That's what allows us to deliver thoughtful solutions that not only look great but also help businesses grow with confidence.
What types of companies do you work with most?

We primarily work with B2B SaaS, AI, and technology companies at different stages of growth, from startups building their first product to established businesses scaling platforms used by thousands of customers. While every company has different goals, they often face similar challenges - creating better user experiences, launching new features, improving conversions, or preparing their products for long-term growth. We take time to understand your product, market, users, and business objectives before recommending an approach. We don't believe every project needs the same solution. Whether you're launching an MVP, modernizing an existing platform, or expanding an established product, our goal is to build solutions that fit your stage of growth - not force you into a one-size-fits-all process.
How do you choose the people who join Orbix Studio?

We believe great products are built by great people, which is why we're intentional about who joins our team. We look beyond technical skills and portfolios, focusing on problem-solving ability, product thinking, communication, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across different disciplines. Every team member is expected to understand the bigger picture - not just complete individual tasks. Whether they're designing a user flow, writing code, creating a brand identity, or producing motion graphics, they need to understand how their work contributes to the overall product experience and business goals. We also believe learning never stops. Our team regularly explores new design practices, development frameworks, AI tools, and emerging technologies to keep improving the way we work. This commitment to continuous growth helps us deliver modern, thoughtful solutions while maintaining the quality and consistency our clients expect. When you work with Orbix Studio, your project isn't assigned to whoever happens to be available. We carefully match the team based on your product, industry, technical requirements, and project goals, ensuring you work with specialists who have the right experience for the challenges you're trying to solve.
How do you build the right team for each project?

Every project starts by understanding what it actually needs before assigning a single person. We look at your product, business goals, industry, technical requirements, timeline, and the type of work involved to determine which specialists will bring the most value to the project. Rather than assigning whoever is available, we build a dedicated team around your specific requirements. Depending on scope, this might include product designers, branding specialists, frontend and backend developers, motion designers, AI creatives, or UX researchers. Each team is led by an experienced project lead who keeps everyone aligned and ensures the project moves forward smoothly. As your product grows, your team can grow with it. We can introduce additional specialists, increase capacity, or shift priorities without disrupting the workflow you've already established. This flexible approach allows us to build a team that's tailored to your project today while remaining ready to support your product as it evolves in the future.
How do you maintain quality across every project?

Quality isn't something we check at the end - it's built into every stage of the project. Before any work is shared with a client, it goes through internal reviews to make sure it meets our standards for usability, visual consistency, technical feasibility, and attention to detail. Every project is guided by an experienced project lead who reviews progress, gathers feedback from the team, and ensures the work aligns with the project's goals before moving to the next stage. This collaborative review process helps us catch issues early, maintain consistency, and deliver work that reflects the same level of quality across every engagement. Our commitment to quality is reflected in the recognition we've earned: Behance badges for digital product design, an i.design Winner award for our GiveHub project, and consistent 5.0 ratings from clients who've experienced this process firsthand. We also rely on proven design systems, documented workflows, and close collaboration between designers and developers to reduce errors and keep everyone aligned. Instead of working in isolation, every discipline contributes throughout the project, helping us deliver solutions that are not only visually polished but also practical, scalable, and ready for real-world use.

Every project works as one shared team, not as separate departments handing work off to each other. From the beginning, designers, developers, branding specialists, motion designers, and other experts work around the same project goals, roadmap, and timeline. This ensures every decision supports the product as a whole rather than being made in isolation. Each project is led by a dedicated project lead who coordinates communication, priorities, and progress across every discipline. Instead of passing work from one team to another, everyone stays connected through shared planning, regular reviews, and continuous feedback. This allows potential issues to be identified early and resolved before they affect the project. By keeping every team aligned throughout the process, we reduce unnecessary revisions, avoid miscommunication, and ensure the final product feels consistent - from the brand and user experience to the code that brings it to life. Our clients don't have to manage multiple specialists or act as the bridge between teams - we take care of that, so you can stay focused on your business.
How do you keep communication simple throughout a project?

You'll always know where your project stands. We keep communication clear by sharing progress throughout the project instead of waiting until the end. As work is completed, you'll receive updates, review what's been done, and have the opportunity to give feedback before moving to the next stage. Rather than overwhelming you with constant meetings, we focus on meaningful check-ins and clear decisions. When we need your input, we'll explain exactly what's needed and why, helping you make decisions quickly without slowing down the project. Our goal is simple: keep you informed, involved, and confident from the first conversation to the final delivery - without adding unnecessary complexity to your day.
How do you help your team stay ahead of design and technology?

Technology, user expectations, and product design are constantly evolving, so learning is built into the way we work. Our designers and developers regularly explore new design systems, AI tools, development frameworks, accessibility standards, and product strategies to improve how we solve problems - not simply to follow trends. We also encourage knowledge sharing across the team. Lessons from client projects, new workflows, emerging technologies, and industry best practices are discussed internally, allowing everyone to learn from real-world experience. Before new tools or processes become part of our workflow, they're tested to ensure they improve quality, efficiency, or collaboration. This continuous learning helps us recommend modern solutions that are practical, scalable, and aligned with the way today's digital products are built, while avoiding trends that don't create real value for our clients.

Clients can expect a structured, collaborative, and transparent experience from the first conversation to the final delivery. Before work begins, we take time to understand your business, product, users, and goals so every recommendation is based on context rather than assumptions. Throughout the project, you'll always know what's being worked on, what's coming next, and when your feedback is needed. We share progress regularly, explain design and technical decisions clearly, and adapt as priorities evolve, so you never feel disconnected from your own project. Most importantly, we believe great partnerships are built on honesty. We'll tell you when we think something can be improved, challenge ideas when there's a better approach, and always recommend solutions that support your product's long-term success. This approach is reflected in our Clutch rating: 5.0 out of 5.0 from 47+ client reviews.
What makes a successful partnership with Orbix?

The strongest partnerships are built on shared goals, open communication, and mutual trust. We bring expertise in product strategy, design, branding, and development, while our clients bring deep knowledge of their business, users, and industry. When both sides work together, better decisions are made and better products are built. We value clients who are open to collaboration, provide timely feedback, and involve us early when important product decisions are being made. That allows us to contribute strategically rather than simply executing individual tasks. In return, we commit to being proactive, transparent, and accountable throughout every stage of the project. Our goal isn't to become another agency you manage - it's to become a trusted product partner that understands your business, grows with your team, and continues creating value as your product evolves.

What happens after I submit the form?

Once you submit the form, our team will review your inquiry and get back to you as soon as possible. If your project is a good fit, we'll schedule a free 30-minute discovery call to learn more about your goals, timeline, and requirements. ‍ After the call, we'll recommend the best approach and, if appropriate, send you a clear proposal with the scope, timeline, team, and pricing. If we're not the right fit, we'll let you know honestly and point you in the right direction. Is the first consultation free? ‍ Yes. Your first 30-minute free discovery call is completely free, with no obligation to move forward. It's an opportunity for us to learn about your product, understand your goals, answer your questions, and discuss the best way to approach your project. ‍ There's no sales pressure - just an honest conversation to see if we're the right fit.

You'll speak directly with a member of our product team, not a salesperson. The conversation is focused on understanding your business, product, and challenges, so you can get practical advice from someone involved in planning and delivering digital products - not someone reading from a sales script.
What should I prepare before the call?

You don't need a detailed project brief to get started. If you have a website, product, Figma file, requirements, or even a rough idea, that's enough. ‍ We'll ask the right questions during the call, help you organize your thoughts, and recommend the best next steps based on where you are today.
Can we sign an NDA first?

Absolutely. We understand that many projects involve confidential ideas, product roadmaps, or sensitive business information. If you'd like to sign an NDA before discussing your project, we're happy to do so. Protecting your information and building a relationship based on trust is an important part of how we work.

It depends on the scope of your project and our current availability, but most projects begin within 5 business days after the proposal is approved. If you have a tight deadline or an upcoming launch, let us know during the discovery call. We'll review your timeline and do our best to recommend the fastest and most practical way to get started.
Can I pause or cancel my subscription?

Yes. We know that priorities change. Funding rounds get delayed, product roadmaps shift, and internal teams sometimes need time to regroup. That's why our subscription plans are designed to give you flexibility instead of locking you into long-term contracts. ‍ If you need to pause your subscription, simply let us know 14 days in advance. We'll wrap up any active work, organize your project files, and hand everything over so your team can continue where we left off. ‍ When you're ready, you can restart your subscription without rebuilding the project from scratch or onboarding a new team. ‍ You can also upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan as your business evolves. Whether you're scaling quickly or slowing down for a few months, our goal is to make the process simple and predictable, so your engagement always matches your current business needs rather than forcing you into a contract that no longer makes sense.
Can I start with a smaller project?

Yes - and many of our long-term partnerships begin that way. You don't have to commit to a large engagement on day one. ‍ If you'd prefer to evaluate how we work together first, we can start with a focused project such as a product audit, landing page, website redesign, brand refresh, MVP feature, or a small UX improvement. ‍ A smaller engagement gives both teams the opportunity to build trust, establish a workflow, and understand the product before expanding into a larger partnership. ‍ It also allows you to see how we communicate, manage feedback, and deliver work without making a significant upfront commitment. If the initial project goes well, scaling is straightforward. Since our team already understands your product, users, and business goals, we can transition into larger projects or an ongoing subscription without losing momentum or starting the process from scratch.

elements.text: Swipe Drinks is a mobile app designed to replace cash at events by using digital tokens to buy beverages.
The project focused on making drink purchases fast and cashless, adding a social layer where users can send tokens to friends, and giving parents control over their children's spending.
UX Design, UI Design, Mobile App Design

Our task was to design Swipe Drinks to serve two very different users. Kids and teens needed a fun, fast, and social way to buy drinks and send tokens to friends. Parents needed a secure way to load tokens, set spending limits, and monitor activity.
People Needed a Clearer Way to Pick Drinks and Use Tokens
We had to make the flow feel easy right away, so users could see what was available, understand their token balance, and keep moving without slowing down.
Getting from the first screen to a drink choice needed to feel more direct.
Users needed a simple way to see what they had and how to use it.
The screens needed more structure so the main actions stood out faster.
The app had to feel tied to the event, not just like a plain drink menu.
Made the Drink Flow Easier to Follow
We simplified the layout, made token use easier to understand, and gave each screen a clearer path so people could move through the app without confusion.
Organized the steps so users could browse, choose, and continue more naturally.
Made token count and usage easier to spot at a glance.
Cleaned up the screens so the main actions felt more focused and easier to scan.
We used a more playful visual style so the app felt tied to the experience.
A Simple Design Process for Swipe Drinks App
The work focused on clearing up the screens, making tokens easier to understand, and keeping the experience easy to move through.
Started by looking at how people would use the app at an event and where the flow could feel unclear.
Mapped out the steps so choosing drinks and using tokens felt more direct.
Built a bright, playful interface that made the app feel fun but still easy to use.
Polished the screens and adjusted details so the final design felt clear and ready to hand off.

Found that the experience needed to feel quick and easy.

The first part of the work focused on how people would . The goal was to make the steps feel clear from the start, so users could understand the drink flow without stopping to figure things out.

That meant looking at how the token system worked, where the screen could feel confusing, and how each step could lead into the next one more naturally. The layout was kept simple so the main actions stayed easy to see.
Giving the App a Fun, Event-Ready Look
The visual side focused on making the app feel bright, playful, and tied to the event experience. The design needed to feel light and easy, while still looking polished and well put together.

Color, spacing, and image treatment were used to make the screens more engaging without making them feel busy. The final look helped the app feel more alive and made the drink experience feel more interesting to use.
